I'm speaking partly on myself and their behalf.

I was at this surgery since birth, and I can say as a teenager trying to get appointments was so challenging, you were cast aside, the reception never picked up the phone, and if you tried to book an appointment in advance, they wouldn't allow it and said you'd have to call at 8:00am on THAT day. When you did call at 8:00am, they either;-
A. Never answer the phone.
B. You're in a queue of 30+ people despite calling at 8:00am on the dot.
C. Told they were no appointments after being on hold for a very, very long time.

After being diagnosed with a condition, which took them years to put a name too, I was told there was no cure and I would have to live with it forever. They didn't even recommend anything to help the condition or subside it. I was in pain for many, many years, it wasn't until I transferred doctors, that I was told properly what the condition was, how it CAN BE MAINTAINED, and directed me straight to the local hospital for an appointment and treatment that is actually working. I had 10+ years taken away from me that was full of embarrassment, pain and no answers.

Myself and family members have had to constantly wait for phone calls, or texts from the doctors that never get received. You have to ring the doctors yourself for results which is beyond bizarre.  Furthermore, one of the worst things is trying to collect your prescription from the local chemist when the doctors haven't even sent it down to them - the amount of times we've travelled back and forth from chemist to doctors to try and find where your prescription was, was a NIGHTMARE and very time consuming.

I know this is a long review, but it's from years and years of frustration. The receptionists don't take you seriously, and their rude on the phone and in person.
